---
title: "Notebooks"
description: "Publication-safe OrPen layout and simulation notebooks rendered with their code and saved outputs."
---

Quarto renders the checked-in Jupyter notebooks as ordinary documentation pages.
Readers can inspect Markdown, cell code, and saved cell output in the static site;
no Python kernel is required after the site is built.

The notebooks remain executable development artifacts. A notebook that needs a
solver, private run folder, or optional application must fail clearly when that
dependency is unavailable; the docs build does not invent output.

## Layout tutorials

- [Public PDK component inventory](notebooks/Public_Docs/component_gallery.ipynb)
- [Martinis ribbon, Route A](notebooks/SGB_Geometry_Tutorials/martinis2022_ribbon_route_a.ipynb)
- [Martinis ribbon, Route B](notebooks/SGB_Geometry_Tutorials/martinis2022_ribbon_route_b.ipynb)
- [Resonator, Route A](notebooks/SGB_Geometry_Tutorials/resonator_route_a.ipynb)
- [Flip-chip spacing, Route A](notebooks/SGB_Geometry_Tutorials/sim_flip_chip_distance_route_a.ipynb)

## Simulation notebooks

- [Interdigital-capacitor Q3D capacitance](notebooks/AEDTSimulation/Components/interdigital_capacitor_q3d_capacitance.ipynb)
- [Two-resonator response](notebooks/AEDTSimulation/Components/two_resonator_bare_and_coupled_response.ipynb)
- [Native masked-surface EPR analysis](notebooks/Native_Masked_Surface_EPR/native_mask_surface_epr_analysis.ipynb)

Checked-in outputs are embedded at build time. To execute a notebook before
rendering, use `quarto render path/to/notebook.ipynb --execute` in an environment
that provides its declared dependencies.
